subject: {requesterEmail} wants to join {tenantName}
preheader: Someone has asked to join your {productName} workspace.
body: {requesterName} ({requesterEmail}) has asked to join {tenantName} on {productName}. If you would like to grant them access, invite them from Settings → Users.
footer: You are receiving this because you are an administrator of {tenantName} on {productName}.
